{{Quote|We, the Beings of the galaxy, in order to form a free union of planets, establish justice, provide for common peace and prosperity, and to secure liberty for all being, do ordain and establish this New Republic. Let the stars sing! Let the planets shout! Let the Republic begin!|Excerpt from the Declaration of a New Republic|<ref name="HttES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''Declaration of a New Republic''' was a document issued by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] that formally established the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and completed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends| Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Alliance of Free Planets|transformation]] from a resistance movement to a galactic [[Politics/Legends|government]]. It spelled out to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] public at large the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|government system]] and ideals of freedom, [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]], and justice that the New Republic hoped to return to [[Galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The Declaration of a New Republic was signed one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="HttES" /><ref name="SWGSR">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref><ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> days after the [[Battle of Zeltros]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="Forgotten War" />

==Signatories==
The signatories were:
*[[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Borsk Fey'lya]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Jenssar SoBilles]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Doman Beruss (Corellian)|Doman Beruss]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Kerrithrarr/Legends|Kerrithrarr]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]<ref name="HttES" />
*[[Verrinnefra B'thog Indriummsegh]] of [[Elom/Legends|Elom]]<ref name="HttES" />

The first four of these signers became the [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]] of the [[New Republic Provisional Council]].

==Behind the scenes==
The excerpt above is similar to the preamble to the [[Wikipedia:United States Constitution|United States Constitution]], much as the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] is similar to the [[Wikipedia:United States Declaration of Independence|United States Declaration of Independence]].

All [[Human/Legends|Human]] signatures, as well as the initials of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] Sian Tevv, are written in English (or, in-universe, using the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].)
